title: Tech Note: Reporting Frontmost Status Tool with 4D
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The Storage object, Workers, and preemptive processing described here (all introduced/expanded around v16R6) remain current, actively used 4D concepts today, so the architecture of this activity-tracking tool is still valid and reusable. Only the platform-specific low-level frontmost-detection code (calling into Mac/Windows APIs) may need periodic revalidation as OS versions change, which is a normal maintenance concern rather than an obsolescence issue.
related_updates: Storage object and Workers remain core 4D concepts
Preemptive process model continues to be used and refined in later 4D versions
OS-level frontmost-window detection code may require updates for newer macOS/Windows versions
